key: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherewith he made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, the golden calves that were in Beth-el, and that were in Dan.
s: After Jehu has Ahab’s house and Baal’s worshippers put to death, the chapter turns to the worship he left standing; Rashi, on 10:29, reads his holding to the calves as fear that the kingdom would return to David’s house, as Jeroboam had feared.

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, 2 Kings 10:29, at [318,29]). Plain sense faithful: 10:7 to 17 Jehu has Ahab’s house slain and 10:18 to 28 the worshippers of Baal, then 10:29 turns to the calves he kept; the killing is stated in one plain clause, no four-word repeat of the key. Rashi’s only comment on 10:29 gives Jehu’s motive as worry lest the kingdom return to the house of David, as Jeroboam had feared; the reading says exactly that and no more. Radak (10:30) and Metzudat David (10:29) add nothing contrary. Entry passes entry-check.
